items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
thou shalt say to the children of Israel
items.claim: Moses was commanded to announce to the children of Israel

items.quote: Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth any of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death
items.claim: Anyone who sacrifices offspring to Molech shall be put to death

items.quote: the people of the land shall stone him with stones
items.claim: The people of the land shall execute by stoning the violator
